title: Paul's unusual word prepares for his appeal through his chains
english: In many of his letters Paul places an unusual word at the start, one that is preparatory for the argument he is about to introduce. Here too, since he was about to make a request on behalf of Onesimus, he shows the credibility of his appeal through his own worth—and his worth is being in chains.
